events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $4.41 (model confidence 0.85)
events.body:

Segment F3 is covered by the reasonable-cause exception. The trace confirms the incident sits on the replaced stretch; F3 is therefore exempt and its 2.69 km is not refundable [F12][RD-4].

Segment F4 is not explained. The trace finds no qualifying incident on the replaced stretch for it [F4][RD-4]. No rider-requested stop names a place either [F9][RD-3]. F4 therefore counts as an unexempted deviation [F4][RD-1].

Amount: the rate is this fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km = $31.84 ÷ 22.58 km = $1.4101/km [F7][RD-2]. The only unexempted segment is F4: 3.13 km × $1.4101/km = $4.4136, rounded to $4.41. Segment F3's 2.69 km is exempt, and the remaining difference between the billed excess (6.70 km) and the two measured segments is not refundable [F5][F3][F4][RD-2]. So refund_partial of $4.41.

No account flag: the driver profile shows 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days, so RD-6's "repeated breach" condition is not met [F15][RD-6].
